bundle.text:
# ocr-review：open-code-review 工作区审查插件（bundle）。
# 双面包机制：本包含 Host 半（host.ts：7 个工具 ocr_review/ocr_scan/
# ocr_delegate_preview/ocr_delegate_rule/ocr_session/ocr_rules_check/ocr_llm + 由 `Config` 上 `.volatile()`
# 隐式投影的设置面（命名空间就是下面这条的 id）+ 设置卡的 `ocrReview` Remote 读面）与
# Client 半（src/client-entry.ts → client.js：设置卡片，从宿主设置服务的
# llm-pi-ai.providers 选 provider/model 应用到
# ~/.opencodereview/config.json，key 走 api_key_cmd 动态读取宿主凭据 ref，
# OCR 配置永不落明文 key）。
#
# 组合包层：本文件由 package.json 的 dsh.bundle.patch 指向，随
# `dsh plugin --profile web add/remove ./plugins/ocr-review` 维护。行按裸包名
# 引用本包（client-modules 只扫描裸包名条目的 dsh.client 声明）。
# pnpm 12.0–12.2 的 `pnpm add <本地目录>` 不可用（上游 #14437：无别名的本地路径被当
# registry 包名解析；12.1.0/12.2.0 复现，12.2.0 的 release notes 无修复），12.3.0 起修复。
# 把本包目录加进 profile 前先确认 pnpm ≥12.3.0；从 registry 装不受影响。
- insert:
    # 故意不写 id：shared 是本包 patch 启用的内部组件行，不是用户可停用的独立组件；
    # 写 id 会让插件页出现一个可关闭的组件，关闭后本包设置卡会失去组件供应。
    - name: "@jayyuen66/dsh-plugin-shared"
    - id: ocr-review
      name: "@jayyuen66/dsh-ocr-review"

readme.section: Introduction
readme.text:
dsh-ocr-review

The external `ocr` (open-code-review) CLI as seven dsh model tools and one settings card — you install the CLI, the plugin only discovers, verifies and drives it.

readme.text: **A code-review bridge for [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): seven model tools (`ocr_review`, `ocr_scan`, delegate preview & rule, `ocr_session`, `ocr_rules_check`, `ocr_llm`) plus a settings card that applies the host's provider/model selection to the external CLI's own config — as a runtime command, never a plaintext key.**

readme.section: What it does
readme.text:
- **One settings card also carries the admin surfaces**: a validated MCP servers JSON editor (saving touches only `mcp_servers`) and a ChatGPT section that reports `ocr auth` status and switches OCR's provider/model. Both are human-managed; neither is a model tool (a stdio MCP server runs commands, and OAuth sign-in needs a browser plus a local callback).
- **Wraps the external `ocr` (open-code-review) CLI into seven model tools.** The host validates tool arguments not at all, so every shape, type and enum gate lives in this package: user-controlled strings are single-quote escaped, enums are whitelist-clamped, and wrong-typed values error instead of silently narrowing or widening a review.
- **One settings card** (the web client half) picks provider/model from the host's own `llm-pi-ai` settings entry and key status from the host credentials service. When either service is absent the card shows the degradation reason; tools and settings keep working.
- **Applying a selection writes the CLI's own `~/.opencodereview/config.json`** — as an `api_key_cmd` command that reads the host credential ref at OCR runtime. The plugin never writes a plaintext key into `config.json`; the `.bak` it

readme.section: Install
readme.text:
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @jayyuen66/dsh-ocr-review
```

Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove @jayyuen66/dsh-ocr-review`. The package is on the public npm registry, so installation needs no credentials.

readme.section: Install
readme.text:
- **Upgrading an installed copy is remove-then-add.** On a profile running HMR (the shipped ones do), `add` on a package the profile already depends on refuses before pnpm runs (`already-installed`) — run `remove` first, then `add` the target version; the new one starts without a restart. Without HMR the same `add` runs pnpm and reports `restart-required`. - **Requires Node.js `>= 24.9` and host `dsh` on the `0.2.1-rc.5` or `0.2.2-alpha.3` line.** The host reads `engines.dsh` (`^0.2.1-rc.5 || ^0.2.2-alpha.3`) and decides on it alone; prereleases participate in the comparison. An incompatible host needs the explicit risk grant `dsh plugin --profile

allow-version @jayyuen66/dsh-ocr-review@ --dsh-version --accept-risk`. The support window rolls: this package is verified against every released host version inside the window at publish time and re-verified once the window moves, so the version number in this bullet is not a standing promise. - **No `@deepseek-ai/*` under `dependencies`, by contract** (`test/publish-manifest.test.ts` enforces it). Consumer profiles install with `nodeLinker: hoisted` and `autoInstallPeers: false`, so a host package there is materializ

readme.section: Shared version floor
readme.text: If your profile pins `@jayyuen66/dsh-plugin-shared` with a pnpm `overrides` entry, that pin must be at least the version this package declares. A lower pin installs a copy without the names imported at runtime, and the host then reports `N entries did not activate` together with `does not provide an export named ...` at boot — the package installs fine and never loads, and no per-repository CI run can see it.

readme.section: The external CLI
readme.text:
This package spawns `ocr`; it never installs or upgrades it. The command contract is verified against **1.13.5** (`EXPECTED_OCR_CLI_VERSION` in `lib/cli.ts`, declared once as `ocrCliVersion` in package.json — tests pin the manifest, the code constant and both READMEs to the same string).

```sh
brew install open-code-review                        # the formula tracks the newest release
npm i -g @alibaba-group/open-code-review@1.13.5      # pinned to the version this plugin verifies against
```

readme.section: The external CLI
readme.text:
- **brew cannot pin.** `homebrew/core` carries one stable formula and no versioned variant, so `brew install` / `brew upgrade` always yields whatever is newest upstream. The npm command is the only one that can carry the verified version.
- **PATH wins, and the refusal is honest.** Command resolution takes the first `ocr` on `PATH`, then a copy inside this package's own dependency tree (skipped on Windows — a shebang script pwsh/cmd cannot execute); with neither, the tools refuse before spawning and hand the model the install commands above with the version filled in. "How it was installed" is read off the real target of the `bin` symlink: npm-style under `node_modules`, a formula under `Cellar` / `Homebrew`, otherwise reported as unrecognised rather than guessed.
- **Version is measured, not assumed.** Reading it spawns `ocr version` (15 s wall clock, always with `OCR_NO_UPDATE=1`) — on the card's Detect button, and once at apply when `startupVerify` is on. Rendering a page never spawns: the card shows the last measurement, or nothing measured yet. A disagreement names both numbers, flips the badge and appends a note to the review summary's `hint`; it is never a hard failure, and

readme.section: Verify it is live
readme.text:
1. **Mounted**: `dsh --profile web --dump-config` ends with this package's layer (`# == @jayyuen666/dsh-ocr-review`).
   - That command is the only accepted "it is in the layer stack" signal, and it is **not read-only** — it rewrites the profile's root assembly file. Read layer lines from stdout **and** check stderr separately: an unmatched patch target appears only on stderr, so the exit code alone proves nothing. Accept both `# == <layer>` and `# == <layer>, patched by <path>`.
2. **The card renders**: the settings page shows the card, and its External CLI row names which copy is in use, how it was installed, and which version this plugin verifies against.
3. **Detect version works**: pressing it runs one `ocr version` and fills the measured version into the row — or names the failure arm (command missing, non-zero exit, timeout, nothing parseable).
4. **Tools answer honestly without the CLI**: on a machine with no `ocr`, `ocr_review` refuses before spawning and returns the install commands with the verified version — not an exit-127 to reverse-derive.

readme.section: What it does not provide
readme.text:
- **It does not install or upgrade the CLI.** The brew/npm commands are shown, never run; there is no update action and no clipboard API (a non-secure context would fail silently, looking like a dead button).
- **No HTTP route of its own.** The data plane is one official Typert Remote namespace (`ocrReview`) through the host `/api` gateway; authentication, Host / DNS-rebinding / Origin checks and body limits are the gateway's. This package holds no CSRF token, no body cap and no route disposer.
- **No CLI subcommand.** `dsh ocr …` does not exist.
- **The plugin itself reads no file outside** the CLI's config path, the host credential document and `$DSH_HOME/.env` (through `scripts/get-cred.mjs`), the PATH directories it probes for the `ocr` binary, the OCR session store it lists, the temp files it creates, and the host settings / credentials services it is handed. Repository contents are read by the `ocr` child process as the reviewed input.
- What it *does* consume: the host `settings` and `credentials` services (provider list, key status), `shell` (every `ocr` subprocess), `jobs` (background runs) and `systemPrompt` (one routing section). A missing settings or credentials service

readme.section: Enabling it in dsh
readme.text:
- `dsh.bundle.patch` in `package.json` points at `cordis.patch.yml`, which carries **two entries**: `- name: "@jayyuen66/dsh-plugin-shared"` (the supplier of the card components, deliberately **without an `id`** so the plugin page does not list it as a switchable component) and `- id: ocr-review` with `name` set to the bare package name — the bare name is what makes the host scan the client half.
- The card needs a web profile (`dsh.client.platform: web`, `immediately: true`). The nine `ocrReview` methods are installed unconditionally on the apply fiber, so a host whose web layer never comes up (a TUI) still has the tools and settings.
- The gateway exposes the methods only to clients of this profile; this package adds nothing in front of it.
- Deployment defaults go on the registration line's `config:` (cordis validates through the exported `Config` schema); precedence: settings-card runtime value > line config > built-in default.

readme.section: Tools exposed to the model
readme.text:
| Tool | Arguments and constraints |
| --- | --- |
| `ocr_review` | repo (absolute path, default = the session workspace), scope workspace/commit/branch (branch needs both from+to and is mutually exclusive with commit), effort, background, exclude, provider/model/resume — resume only with commit/branch; a workspace run cannot be resumed. preview (file-selection only), noFilter, maxGitProcs, rule/backgroundFile (repo-root files only), wait |
| Numeric group (review and scan) | concurrency / timeoutMinutes / maxTools / maxTokens / maxTokensBudget, mapped to `--concurrency` `--timeout` `--max-tools` `--max-tokens` `--max-tokens-budget`. Values pass through faithfully; min floors are 1 for concurrency and 0 for the rest, and non-integers or below-floor values error instead of clamping |
| `ocr_scan` | repo, path, exclude, batch none/by-language/by-directory, provider/model (the CLI's native shared flags), the same numeric group, preview, noPlan/noDedup/noSummary, resume, maxGitProcs, rule (repo-root file), wait. Whole-repo scanning, no git diff required |
| `ocr_delegate_preview` / `ocr_delegate_rule` | preview: repo, scope/commit/from/to, exclude, background, backgroundFile/rule/maxGi

readme.section: Tools exposed to the model
readme.text: `wait: false` starts a background run with no host deadline (poll `ocr_session`; the subprocess is also an official job, see [Background runs as host jobs](#background-runs-as-host-jobs)), and on POSIX the reaper guard takes the OCR process tree down when dsh exits in any way (Windows has no reaper, see [Platforms](#platforms)). Cancelling the tool call stops the corresponding background process.

readme.section: Settings
readme.text: The namespace is the entry id `ocr-review`; the card fields are the `.volatile()` ones.

readme.section: Settings
readme.text:
| Field | Values, default, use |
| --- | --- |
| `effort` | auto/low/medium/high, default auto; `auto` omits `--effort` so OCR's own configured effort wins. Used when `ocr_review` is called without an explicit effort |
| `language` | 中文/English, default 中文; written as the top-level `language` key of the CLI config when a selection is applied |
| `autoVerify` | default true; a successful select also runs `ocr llm test` (capped by `llmTestTimeoutMs`) |
| `maxComments` | default 12, the number of comments kept in the summary; 0 = no truncation, non-integers and negatives fall back to 12 |
| `timeoutMinutes` | default 0 = request the host cap (the host clamps to min(request, shell.maxTimeoutMs)); above 0 is a number of minutes |
| `ocrConfigPath` | Where the CLI config lives; empty derives `<home>/.opencodereview/config.json`, `~` and `~/` prefixes accepted, relative paths error. A custom value must follow the `<X>/.opencodereview/config.json` layout — the CLI has no file-level path override, so the plugin injects `HOME=<X>` into the subprocess (config and sessions redirect together); anything else is rejected at the setting layer. POSIX-only: Windows has no such channel |

readme.section: Settings
readme.text: The deployment keys below are deliberately **not** on the card — they are plain (non-volatile) fields of the exported `Config`, settable only on the profile's `config:` line and taking effect on restart:

readme.section: Settings
readme.text:
| Key | Default | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `llmTestTimeoutMs` | `90000` | Wall clock for `ocr llm test`, shared by autoVerify and the card's test connection; raise it on slow machines |
| `startupVerify` | `true` | Run the endpoint self-check (and one version measurement) at apply. The same switch governs both, because the criterion is "may a load spawn processes"; turn it off if loads must stay process-free |
| `ocrBackgroundMaxMs` | `0` | Backstop window for background reviews (registry wait to the deadline, then kill); 0 = no window — an owned run also ends when its session stops, while an agentless one ends only when the host exits, the plugin unloads or the job is killed |
| `stdoutMaxBytes` | `400000` | Shell executor stdout cap, shared by foreground and background runs (review results go through the `--output` temp file precisely to step outside it) |
| `ocrNoAutoUpdate` | `false` | true puts `OCR_NO_UPDATE=1` on every command this package spawns, stopping upstream's mid-review `npm i -g` of a newer release; false keeps upstream behaviour. The version probe sets the variable regardless |
| `ocrInstallHint` | `both` | Which install command to lead with when nothing is inst

readme.section: Public interface
readme.text: One official Typert Remote namespace, `ocrReview` (`OCR_REMOTE_NAMESPACE` in `lib/remote-shape.ts`), its nine methods marked programmatically in `host.ts`. The service registers at construction and is withdrawn with its fiber, so a hot reload cannot leave a stale namespace behind.

readme.section: Public interface
readme.text:
| Method | Input | Success payload |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `providers()` | — | `{providers (each with a hasKey boolean), current, getCredReady, source, endpointVerify, ocrBinary}` — never a key. `ocrBinary` carries the filesystem-only availability verdict plus the version context (`source`, `channel`, `expectedVersion`, `measuredVersion: string \| null`, `installHint`); reading this method never spawns |
| `select(request)` | `{provider, model}`, both must hit the list `describe()` returns | `{ok, applied, llmTest}` (`llmTest` is null when `autoVerify` is off) |
| `migrate()` | — | `{ok, migrated, skippedUnknown}` |
| `test()` | — | `{ok, output}` — `ok` is the **test verdict**, not whether the call ran; output is redacted first, then cut to 8000 characters |
| `probe()` | — | `{ok, version, expectedVersion, consistent, output, reason, changeText}` — one `ocr version` under a 15 s wall clock, with `OCR_NO_UPDATE=1`. `consistent` is three-state (`null` = nothing was measured, where claiming a mismatch would be claiming without evidence); `reason` names the failure arm; `changeText` carries the install/upgrade sentence only when there is a command to give |
| `mcp()` | — | `{ok, json

readme.section: Public interface
readme.text: Refusals answer `{ok: false, error, status}` where `status` is a **retained semantic code, not an HTTP status** (400 for an empty or off-list selection, 500 for a failed write or a missing credential script) — the number lets the tests pin which rule fired, and the client renders `error` only. There is deliberately no client-side wall clock on these calls: the timeout belongs to the gateway, and a second one in the card is how a slow write gets reported lost while it actually landed.

readme.section: Credentials and the OCR config file
readme.text:
| Aspect | Fact |
| --- | --- |
| What lands in the config | A command, not a secret: `api_key_cmd` = `node '<path of scripts/get-cred.mjs in this package>' '<REF>' '<dsh data dir>'` — single-quote escaped on POSIX, double-quote escaped on Windows (the CLI runs credential commands through `cmd.exe` there). The data directory is the host's current resolved home, so get-cred's fallback layers stay correct when `HOME` is redirected; the REF name must satisfy the official ref-name rule or the command is refused |
| Layer order | get-cred reads the same three layers in the same order as the official credentials-local: `refs.<REF>` in the managed credentials file first, then the inherited process environment, then `$DSH_HOME/.env`. The host treats the managed file as the effective credential, so a wrong order fails silently — OCR authenticates against a different key than the card reports while both sides show success |
| Reachability gate | select and migrate refuse a key the CLI cannot read at runtime: dsh strips `KEY`/`PASSWORD`/`SECRET`/`TOKEN`-named and `DSH_`-prefixed variables from spawned shells, and the reviewed repository's `.env` is deliberately not read. Keys living only in t

readme.section: Background runs as host jobs
readme.text:
| Aspect | Fact |
| --- | --- |
| What the model gains | `job_list` shows the review, `job_output` reads its stdout/stderr (non-consuming — it never steals bytes from the session reader), `job_kill` stops it. Results still come from the `ocr_session` record |
| No registry, no background | A host without the jobs service makes `wait: false` throw an error naming the missing piece instead of starting a subprocess nobody can observe; foreground runs are unaffected |
| Ownership | When the calling agent resolves to a live session, the job is started with that session as its `owner`; `job_list` / `job_output` / `job_kill` then only reach it from that session. A call with no live agent starts an agentless job |
| Capacity buckets | Owned jobs count against their owner's bucket; agentless jobs share the unowned bucket host-wide. Overflow refuses a new start, so one hung CLI can park a slot — the optional `ocrBackgroundMaxMs` backstop uses the registry's own wait + kill, not a host timer |
| Cleanup | Before each start, settled records of this kind visible to that caller (the shared unowned bucket plus the caller's own) are pruned to a fixed window; live and stopping records are never pru

readme.section: Data and privacy
readme.text:
| Aspect | Fact |
| --- | --- |
| Process boundary | The reviewed repository's paths and diff content go into the `ocr` child process, and the CLI sends them to the LLM endpoint configured in its own config.json — that egress is the review feature itself and does not pass through the dsh host. Plaintext keys never appear in tool results or Remote payloads; a value resolved by the host is used only to confirm "it resolves right now" and is discarded on the spot |
| Redaction | All raw CLI stdout/stderr leaving this package (failure details, llm test, parse-failure echoes, session passthrough) goes through `redactKeyMaterial()`: bearer and assignment forms strictly, the standalone-key form only with random-string features, so file paths handed to the model are not erased with it |
| On disk | The CLI's `config.json` (plus its temp sibling, the `.bak` backup and the short-lived lock), the `ocr-review-*` / `ocr-scan-*` temp files (deleted right after reading), and `ocr-session-export-*` directories, which hold the HTML returned by `ocr_session` `export` and are left in place for the caller. Pre-migration plaintext may persist in that `.bak` (mode 0600) — delete the backup yourself to b

readme.section: Known boundaries
readme.text:
- **Windows gets no reaper and no custom config path.** Both rest on a POSIX toolchain (bash traps, process-group semantics, the `HOME=` assignment prefix); on Windows the package runs the bare command un-reaped, and a hard host exit can leave an orphaned OCR process.
- **A version mismatch is never a hard failure.** A newer CLI usually works; both numbers are shown, the badge flips, and the summary's `hint` says so. This package never runs an installer.
- **Version reads cost a spawn** and never happen on render; the card shows the last measurement or nothing — a page render cannot install, update or probe anything.
- **The atomic-write lock timeout surfaces in English.** Contention past the official wait budget throws the official package's own timeout text — the one user-visible error here that bypasses the bilingual message table.
- **`partial` is a terminal success state.** Some files failed but coverage stands and the comments are valid; it is neither upgraded to success nor folded into failure.
- **Agentless background jobs are visible to every session** (see Background runs). A call that cannot resolve a live agent starts one; owned jobs are fenced to their session.

readme.section: FAQ
readme.text:
| Question / symptom | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| Exit 0 was taken as a successful review | Exit 0 is not success: any `status` outside success / complete / partial / completed_with_warnings / completed_with_errors / skipped reports as failure. `partial` means some files failed while coverage and the comments stand. A parse failure echoes the first 500 redacted UTF-16 code units of the raw output |
| Did the summary cover everything? | Two notions, neither replaces the other. `droppedCount` / `invalidCommentCount` say whether **this summary** listed every comment (raise `maxComments` or set 0 and re-check). Whether **the run** covered the selected files is `coverage` (`selected` is the denominator, `failedItems` names the files with their reasons) plus `budgetExceeded` and `toolCalls` |
| `add` was refused with `already-installed` | HMR profiles refuse `add` on an already-installed package before pnpm runs — `remove` first, then `add` the target version (see Install) |
| What happens to background processes when dsh exits? | On POSIX the reaper guard takes the review/scan process tree down with TERM→1s→KILL on any host exit (including kill -9 followed by adoption); Windows has no rea

readme.section: Development
readme.text:
```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run check   # typecheck (both sides) → lint → client build → host build → tests with coverage → format
```

readme.section: Development
readme.text:
- Coverage thresholds are **100%** across four metrics over the surface `vitest.config.ts` opts into (`coverageInclude`: `host.ts` + `lib/**`); two areas are deliberately outside it: the client half (`src/**`) is exercised through the bundle and the settings-card tests, and `scripts/get-cred.mjs` is driven by process-level tests spawning a child (v8 coverage cannot see a child process) — its behavioral gate lives in `test/get-cred.test.ts`.
- Adding this package's **local directory** to a profile (`pnpm add <path>`) needs pnpm ≥ 12.3.0: earlier pnpm 12 releases resolve an unaliased local path as a registry package name (upstream #14437, fixed in 12.3.0). Installing from the registry is unaffected.
- Bundle freshness is pinned by `test/build-host.test.ts`: a stale `host.js` / `client.js` fails the suite. Never hand-edit the bundles; `prepare` rebuilds them.
- The plugin source is TypeScript loaded directly by the host's cordis loader (Node ≥ 22.18 type stripping); the bundles exist for the published npm surface. Installing from a local path (`pnpm add <path>`) therefore reads the source and needs Node ≥ 22.18, while this package's own declared floor is `engines.node` (`>=24.9.0`).

readme.section: 它做什么
readme.text:
- **设置卡还承载两块管理面**：可校验的 MCP servers JSON 编辑器（保存只改 `mcp_servers`），以及报告 `ocr auth` 登录态并切换 OCR provider/model 的 ChatGPT 区。两块都由人操作，不是模型工具（stdio MCP server 会执行命令，OAuth 登录需要浏览器与本地回调）。
- **把外部 `ocr`（open-code-review）CLI 封装成七个模型工具。** 宿主对工具入参零校验，形状、类型与枚举闸全在本包内：用户可控字符串一律单引号转义，枚举一律白名单钳制，错类型直接报错——绝不静默收窄或放宽审查范围。
- **一张设置卡片**（client 半）从宿主自己的 `llm-pi-ai` 设置条目取 provider/model 清单、从宿主凭据服务取 key 状态。两个服务缺席时卡片显示降级原因，工具与设置照常可用。
- **应用一次选择写的是 CLI 自己的 `~/.opencodereview/config.json`**——写进去的是 `api_key_cmd` 命令，OCR 运行期经它读宿主凭据 ref；本包不把明文 key 写进 `config.json`，但首次改写前复制的 `.bak` 保留改写前的整份内容，其中可能有迁移前的明文 key（权限 0600），迁移后自行删除该备份。
- **评审结果是一份结构化摘要，字段分两套口径**：OCR 审出了什么（`status`/`aggregation`/`topComments`/`warnings`），以及这一场有没有真把选中的文件审完（`coverage`/`budgetExceeded`/`toolCalls`）。CLI 以 `--audience agent` 被调用，进度输出被它压掉——后一套口径只能从这些字段里读。
- **CLI 可得性只有一份判据**（`lib/cli.ts` 的 `resolveOcrAvailability`）：纯读文件系统、绝不起进程、每次调用现读。设置卡状态行、插件详情页徽标与启用指引渲染的都是这同一份答案，「用的是哪一份」不许有三套说法。
- **后台运行（`wait: false`）是官方宿主作业**：`job_list` / `job_output` / `job_kill` 看得见、读得到、也停得掉一场超出工具调用生命周期的评审。

readme.section: 安装
readme.text:
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @jayyuen66/dsh-ocr-review
```

卸载用 `dsh plugin --profile web remove @jayyuen66/dsh-ocr-review`。包在公共 npm 上，安装不需要凭据。

readme.section: 安装
readme.text:
- **升级已装的那一份要「先 remove 再 add」。** profile 跑着 HMR（出厂那几个都跑）时，`add` 一个 profile 已经依赖着的包会在 pnpm 动手之前就被拒（`already-installed`）——先 `remove` 再 `add` 目标版本，新版不必重启就起跑。没跑 HMR 时同一个 `add` 照样走 pnpm，报 `restart-required`。 - **要求 Node.js `>= 24.9`，宿主 dsh 在 `0.2.1-rc.5` 或 `0.2.2-alpha.3` 线上。** 宿主只读 `engines.dsh`（`^0.2.1-rc.5 || ^0.2.2-alpha.3`）并独立裁决，预发布号参与比较。不合的宿主要显式登记风险豁免：`dsh plugin --profile

allow-version @jayyuen66/dsh-ocr-review@<版本> --dsh-version <确切运行版本> --accept-risk`。支持窗口是滚动的：本包在发布时把窗口内的每个已发布宿主版本逐版取证，窗口滚动后重新取证，不把这一句里的版本号当长期承诺。 - **`dependencies` 里不放任何 `@deepseek-ai/*`，这是契约**（`test/publish-manifest.test.ts` 钉着）。消费方 profile 用 `nodeLinker: hoisted` 与 `autoInstallPeers: false` 安装，宿主包进了那张表就会落成真实目录，与宿主进程已加载的那份并存。`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 的调度器键是普通 `Symbol`（不是 `Symbol.for`），符号身份按实例计算——那个 profile 里**每一次原生工具调用都抛**，而本包的构建、类型检查与覆盖率门在此前一路绿。 - **`host.js` 以值导入的五枚宿主包是非 optional 的 peer**：`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（宿主 fork——`.volatile()` 的解析只在它有实现）、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-credentials`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-atomic-write` 与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol`（Remote 的 Service 基类）。五枚同时以同一钉版另列进 `devDependencies`，本仓自己的类型检查才解析得到；构建对 manifest 三张表一律外部化，产物里保持裸说明符。 - **发布面**（以 `package.json` 的 `fil

readme.section: shared 的版本下限
readme.text: 如果你的 profile 用 pnpm `overrides` 把 `@jayyuen66/dsh-plugin-shared` 钉在某个版本，那个钉住的值必须不低于本包声明的版本。钉得更低就会装到一份缺少本包运行期所导入的名字的产物，宿主起来时报 `N entries did not activate` 加 `does not provide an export named ...`——包装得上、永远不生效，而各仓单仓 CI 看不见这一类。

readme.section: 外部 CLI
readme.text:
本包只 spawn `ocr`，从不安装或升级它。命令契约按 **1.13.5** 核对（`lib/cli.ts` 的 `EXPECTED_OCR_CLI_VERSION`，版本号只在 package.json 的 `ocrCliVersion` 声明一次——测试把 manifest、代码常量与两侧 README 钉成同一个串）。

```sh
brew install open-code-review                        # formula 只跟上游最新版
npm i -g @alibaba-group/open-code-review@1.13.5      # 钉在本包核对的那一版
```

readme.section: 外部 CLI
readme.text:
- **brew 钉不住版本。** `homebrew/core` 里只有一份 stable formula、没有版本化变体，`brew install` / `brew upgrade` 拿到的永远是上游最新。带得上核对版本的只有 npm 那条。
- **PATH 优先，拒绝也说人话。** 命令词解析先取 PATH 上第一个 `ocr`，其次本包依赖树里那份兜底（Windows 整体跳过——shebang 脚本 pwsh/cmd 执行不了）；两处都没有时，工具在起进程之前就拒绝，并把带版本的装法交给模型。「怎么装上的」看 bin 软链真正指向的文件：落在 `node_modules` 下是 npm 一类，落在 `Cellar` / `Homebrew` 下是 formula，都不是就报「未识别」而不猜。
- **版本是量出来的，不是猜出来的。** 读版本要 spawn 一次 `ocr version`（15 秒墙钟，恒定带 `OCR_NO_UPDATE=1`）——两处会跑：卡片上的「检测版本」按钮，以及 `startupVerify` 开着时装载期那一次。页面渲染绝不起进程：卡片只显示最近一次测量，没测过就不显示。版本对不上时两个数字并列、徽标改口、摘要 `hint` 加一句说明；从不当成硬失败，本包也不执行任何安装动作。
- **上游会自己升级。** npm 包装层会在调用过程中自行执行 `npm i -g @alibaba-group/open-code-review@<latest>`。版本探测恒定拦住这条路；`ocrNoAutoUpdate` 再把拦截扩到本包起的每一条命令（见「设置项」）。
- **从随包分发过 CLI 的版本升上来**（`optionalDependencies`，0.1.5-rc 及更早）：什么都不必做——现在 PATH 优先，旧的那份不再遮蔽你自装的。想清掉 profile 依赖树里那份，在该 profile 目录下移除该包，并删掉当初写在它 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里的 `allowBuilds` 条目。
- **平台。** 目标是 macOS 与 Linux：进程收割与自定义 `ocrConfigPath` 背后的 `HOME=` 注入都是 POSIX 专属。Windows 按裸命令执行、不收割（宿主硬退出可能留下孤儿 OCR 进程），且要求 PATH 上有全局 `ocr`。

readme.section: 确认它真的在工作
readme.text:
1. **层已挂载**：`dsh --profile web --dump-config` 末尾有本包的层行（`# == @jayyuen66/dsh-ocr-review`）。
   - 这条命令是唯一被认的「层进了栈」判据，而且它**不是只读的**——会把该 profile 的根装配文件重写一遍。层行从 stdout 读、stderr 另行检查：未匹配的 patch 目标只出现在 stderr，光看退出码什么也证明不了。`# == <层>` 与 `# == <层>, patched by <路径>` 两种形态都要认。
2. **卡片渲染**：设置页出现本包卡片，外部 CLI 那一行写明用的是哪一份、什么装法、本插件按哪一版核对。
3. **检测版本可用**：按下后跑一次 `ocr version`，把实测版本填进那一行——失败时点名是哪一档（找不到命令词、非零退出、超时、读不出版本号）。
4. **没有 CLI 时工具答得诚实**：机器上没有 `ocr` 时，`ocr_review` 在起进程之前就拒绝，并返回带核对版本的装法命令——而不是让模型去反推一个 exit 127。

readme.section: 它不提供什么
readme.text:
- **它不安装、不升级 CLI。** brew/npm 命令只展示、不执行；没有更新动作，也不接剪贴板 API（非安全上下文会静默失败，看上去像按钮没反应）。
- **没有自己的 HTTP 路由。** 数据面是一枚官方 Typert Remote 命名空间（`ocrReview`），经宿主 `/api` 网关到达；认证、Host / DNS 重绑定 / Origin 判据与请求体上限都是网关的。本包没有 CSRF token、没有 body 上限，也没有路由释放器。
- **没有 CLI 子命令。** 不存在 `dsh ocr …`。
- **本插件自己不读以下范围之外的文件**：CLI 配置路径、宿主凭据文档与 `$DSH_HOME/.env`（经 `scripts/get-cred.mjs`）、为找 `ocr` 二进制而探测的 PATH 目录、`ocr_session` 列出的会话存储、自己创建的临时文件，以及宿主交给它的设置 / 凭据服务。被审查仓库的内容由 `ocr` 子进程作为评审输入读取。
- 它*确实*消费的：宿主 `settings` 与 `credentials` 服务（provider 清单、key 状态）、`shell`（每一条 `ocr` 子进程）、`jobs`（后台运行）与 `systemPrompt`（一段路由）。settings 或 credentials 缺席只降级卡片——工具照常可用。

readme.section: 在 dsh 里启用
readme.text:
- `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`，里面是**两条条目**：`- name: "@jayyuen66/dsh-plugin-shared"`（卡片组件的供应行，**刻意不写 `id`**，所以插件页不会把它列成可停用组件）与 `- id: ocr-review`、`name` 为裸包名——宿主只按裸包名扫描 client 半。
- 卡片要 web profile（`dsh.client.platform: web`、`immediately: true`）。九个 `ocrReview` 方法由 apply fiber 无条件注册，宿主的 web 层从不起（如 TUI）时工具与设置照常在。
- 网关只把方法暴露给本 profile 的客户端；本包不在它前面再加一层。
- 部署默认写在注册行的 `config:` 上（cordis 按导出的 `Config` schema 校验）；优先级：设置卡运行时值 > 行 config > 内置默认。

readme.section: 提供给模型的工具
readme.text:
| 工具 | 入参与约束 |
| --- | --- |
| `ocr_review` | repo（绝对路径，缺省=当前会话工作区）、scope workspace/commit/branch（branch 需同时给 from+to，且与 commit 互斥）、effort、background、exclude、provider/model/resume——resume 仅限 commit/branch，workspace 不支持恢复。preview（只做文件选择）、noFilter、maxGitProcs、rule/backgroundFile（仅 repo 根内文件）、wait |
| 数值参数组（review 与 scan） | concurrency / timeoutMinutes / maxTools / maxTokens / maxTokensBudget，落 `--concurrency` `--timeout` `--max-tools` `--max-tokens` `--max-tokens-budget`。取值忠实透传；下限 concurrency 为 1、其余为 0，非整数或低于下限直接报错，不钳制 |
| `ocr_scan` | repo、path、exclude、batch none/by-language/by-directory、provider/model（CLI 原生共享旗标）、同一组数值参数、preview、noPlan/noDedup/noSummary、resume、maxGitProcs、rule（repo 根内文件）、wait。整仓扫描，无需 git diff |
| `ocr_delegate_preview` / `ocr_delegate_rule` | preview：repo、scope/commit/from/to、exclude、background、backgroundFile/rule/maxGitProcs。rule：repo 加 paths——必填、最多 200 条、经 `--` 分隔作位置参数、逐条转义——外加 rule。OCR 端零 LLM 消耗：只回文件清单与规则分组 |
| `ocr_session` | repo、action list/show/comments/compare/export、id、before/after（compare）、severity/category（comments 过滤）、limit——缺省 10；显式给出必须是 1–100 的整数，越界报错而不是钳制。compare 返回四桶，export 返回 HTML 路径 |
| `ocr_rules_check` | repo、path（必填）、rule（repo 根内文件）：打印命中的规则层、gl

readme.section: 提供给模型的工具
readme.text: `wait: false` 起后台运行、不挂宿主 deadline（用 `ocr_session` 轮询；该子进程同时是一枚官方作业，见[后台运行与官方作业](#后台运行与官方作业)）；POSIX 上 dsh 以任何方式退出时，收割守护把 OCR 进程树收走（Windows 没有收割，见「已知边界」）。取消工具调用即终止对应的后台进程。

readme.section: 设置项
readme.text:
| 字段 | 取值、默认与用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `effort` | auto/low/medium/high，内置默认 auto；`auto` 不传 `--effort`，让 OCR 自己的配置生效。`ocr_review` 未显式传 effort 时用它 |
| `language` | 中文/English，默认 中文；应用选择时作为顶层 `language` 键写进 CLI config |
| `autoVerify` | 默认 true；select 成功后自动跑一次 `ocr llm test`（上限由 `llmTestTimeoutMs` 管） |
| `maxComments` | 默认 12，即摘要保留条数；0 = 不截断，非整数或负数回退 12 |
| `timeoutMinutes` | 默认 0 = 请求宿主上限（宿主按 min(请求, shell.maxTimeoutMs) 收口）；大于 0 为分钟数 |
| `ocrConfigPath` | CLI 配置的位置；留空按 `<home>/.opencodereview/config.json` 派生，接受 `~` 与 `~/` 前缀，相对路径直接报错。自定义值必须是 `<X>/.opencodereview/config.json` 布局——CLI 没有配置文件级的路径覆盖，插件靠给子进程注入 `HOME=<X>` 让它生效（config 与 sessions 一并重定向）；布局外的路径在设置层就拒绝。仅 POSIX：Windows 无此通道 |

readme.section: 设置项
readme.text: 下面这些**部署键**刻意不进设置卡——它们是导出 `Config` 上的普通（非 volatile）字段，只能写在 profile 注册行的 `config:` 上，改值随重启生效：

readme.section: 设置项
readme.text:
| 键 | 默认 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `llmTestTimeoutMs` | `90000` | `ocr llm test` 的墙钟，autoVerify 与卡片「测试连接」共用；评审机慢就调大 |
| `startupVerify` | `true` | 装载期跑一次端点自检（顺带量一次版本）。两条归同一开关，因为判据同是「装载期允不允许起进程」；要求装载零进程的部署关掉它 |
| `ocrBackgroundMaxMs` | `0` | 后台评审的兜底回收窗口（注册表等到 deadline 即 kill）；0 = 不设窗口——有主作业还会在所属会话停止时结束，无主作业则只在宿主退出、插件卸载或作业被杀时结束 |
| `stdoutMaxBytes` | `400000` | shell 执行器的 stdout 缓冲上限，前台与后台共用（评审结果走 `--output` 临时文件，正是为了绕开它） |
| `ocrNoAutoUpdate` | `false` | 置真时本包起的每条命令都带 `OCR_NO_UPDATE=1`，拦住上游在评审中途把新版 `npm i -g` 装上；置假保持上游行为。版本探测不受本开关影响，恒定带上该变量 |
| `ocrInstallHint` | `both` | 还没装时先推哪条装法：`both` / `brew` / `npm`。只是兜底而非覆盖——机器上已有一份时按那份自己的来源说，因为对着 brew 用户端出 `npm i -g` 会多出第二份、PATH 上还是旧的。npm 那条恒带核对版本，brew 那条恒带不了 |

readme.section: 对外接口
readme.text: 一枚官方 Typert Remote 命名空间 `ocrReview`（`lib/remote-shape.ts` 的 `OCR_REMOTE_NAMESPACE`），九个方法在 `host.ts` 里以程序化方式打标记。服务在构造时注册、随所属 fiber 撤回，热重载留不下没人撤的旧命名空间。

readme.section: 对外接口
readme.text:
| 方法 | 入参 | 成功回执 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `providers()` | — | `{providers（每条附 hasKey 布尔）, current, getCredReady, source, endpointVerify, ocrBinary}`，不含任何明文 key。`ocrBinary` 是那份纯文件系统的可得性判定再补上版本上下文（`source`、`channel`、`expectedVersion`、`measuredVersion: string \| null`、`installHint`）；读这个方法不起进程 |
| `select(request)` | `{provider, model}`，两者必须命中 `describe()` 给的清单 | `{ok, applied, llmTest}`（`autoVerify` 关闭时 `llmTest` 为 null） |
| `migrate()` | — | `{ok, migrated, skippedUnknown}` |
| `test()` | — | `{ok, output}`——`ok` 是**测试结论**，不是这次调用成没成；output 先脱敏再截前 8000 个 UTF-16 码元 |
| `probe()` | — | `{ok, version, expectedVersion, consistent, output, reason, changeText}`——15 秒墙钟内跑一次 `ocr version`，恒定带 `OCR_NO_UPDATE=1`。`consistent` 是三态（`null` = 没量到，此时宣称「不一致」就是把没证据的事说成结论）；`reason` 点名失败那一档；`changeText` 只在真有一条该给的命令时非空 |
| `mcp()` | — | `{ok, json, revision}`——只回 `mcp_servers` 对象（pretty JSON），不含 providers/keys；`revision` 是这一支的摘要 |
| `saveMcp(request)` | `{json, revision?}`——原始 JSON 文本，上限 64 KiB；stdio/remote 条目逐字段校验；`revision` 取 `mcp()` 交回的那一枚 | `{ok, count, revision}`——只写 `mcp_servers`，其他配置原样保留。基线过期时整笔拒绝（盘上不动）并回可读的「读取之后已被改动」；不带基线则沿用原来的后写覆盖 |
| `auth()` | — | `{ok, output, loginCommand}`——只读 `ocr auth statu

readme.section: 对外接口
readme.text: 被拒时答 `{ok: false, error, status}`，其中 `status` 是**保留下来的语义码、不是 HTTP 状态**（选择为空或不在清单上是 400，写失败或凭据脚本缺失是 500）——那个数字的作用是让测试钉住是哪条判据拦的，客户端只渲染 `error`。这些调用刻意不带客户端墙钟：超时归网关管，卡片再设一枚就是「写得慢的那次被判成丢了，而它其实落了」。

readme.section: 凭据与 OCR 配置文件
readme.text:
| 面 | 事实 |
| --- | --- |
| 写进 config 的是什么 | 命令不是明文：`api_key_cmd` = `node '<本包 scripts/get-cred.mjs 的路径>' '<REF>' '<dsh 数据目录>'`——POSIX 单引号转义，Windows 双引号转义（CLI 在那边经 `cmd.exe` 跑凭据命令）。数据目录是宿主此刻解析出的 home，HOME 被重定向时 get-cred 的兜底层不会跑偏；REF 名必须满足官方 ref 名规则，否则拒绝构造 |
| 取值层序 | get-cred 三层的先后照抄官方 credentials-local：托管凭据文件里的 `refs.<REF>` 优先，其次继承来的进程环境，再次 `$DSH_HOME/.env`。宿主认「托管文件里那一份才是有效的」，排错一位不会报错——OCR 打的是另一个 key，而卡片与 OCR 两边都显示成功 |
| 可达性闸 | select 与 migrate 拒绝「CLI 运行时取不到」的 key：dsh 起 shell 会剥掉名字含 `KEY`/`PASSWORD`/`SECRET`/`TOKEN` 或 `DSH_` 前缀的变量，被审查仓库的 `.env` 也刻意不读。只存在于 dsh 进程环境或工作区 `.env` 的 key 在宿主侧解析得到、CLI 运行时却取不到——旧行为是「select 成功、OCR 401」的假绿。拒绝发生在写盘之前，错误文本写明补救方式 |
| 写入方式 | 走官方原子替换：同目录随机后缀临时文件 → rename，新 inode 携带 0600；`.bak` 备份由本包在 rename 之前复制。整段「读→判→写」由官方文件锁串行化——`config.json.lock` 短暂出现、`finally` 里删除。现有 config 是坏 JSON 或顶层非对象时中止写入，绝不「按空配置覆盖」 |
| `migrate()` | 把 custom provider 条目里的明文 `api_key` 换成 `api_key_cmd` 并删除明文；key 所在层在 CLI 运行时不可达（与 select 同一道闸）或 settings 里查不到 `apiKeyEnv` 的条目原样不动、列进 `skippedUnknown`；一条都没迁移成功时不写盘 |
| `scripts/get-cred.mjs` | 由 CLI 自己起进程调用，是本包唯一还在读宿主凭据文件的地方。三层全落空时非零退出，并把查过的位置一并报出 |

readme.section: 后台运行与官方作业
readme.text:
| 面 | 事实 |
| --- | --- |
| 模型多看到的 | `job_list` 列得出这场评审、`job_output` 读得到它的 stdout/stderr（非消费式——不会从会话读取器那里抢字节）、`job_kill` 停得掉它。评审结果仍以 `ocr_session` 会话记录为准 |
| 没注册表就没后台 | 宿主没有 jobs 服务时，`wait: false` 直接抛错点名缺件，而不是起一个没人看得见的子进程；前台运行不受影响 |
| 归属 | 调用方能解析到活会话时，作业以该会话为 `owner` 登记；此后只有那个会话能经 `job_list` / `job_output` / `job_kill` 碰到它。解析不到活 Agent 的调用起的是无主作业 |
| 容量桶 | 有主作业计入各自 owner 的桶；无主作业共用全宿主的未拥有桶。满员都直接拒绝新 start，一条挂死的 CLI 会占住一格——`ocrBackgroundMaxMs` 那个可选兜底窗口就是为它设的，用注册表自己的 wait + kill，不用宿主 timer |
| 清理 | 每次登记前，把该 caller 可见面（无主桶 + 自己的）里本 kind 的已落定记录剪到固定窗口；在跑与正在收的一条不剪（注册表对超额的答法是拒绝，不是替人杀评审）。会话销毁只回收该会话的作业；卸载时统一回收全部，有主作业的 id 靠一份最小的「id → owner」台账枚举，因为注册表对别的 owner 隐藏它们 |
| 暴露面 | 有主作业只对所属会话可见、也只由它可 kill。无主作业仍对所有 caller 可见——这是残留暴露面，只发生在解析不到活 Agent 的时候 |
| 取消链里不许抛 | 宿主事件处理器里抛出的错误会把整个宿主进程带下来，官方件也不替生产者兜——取消链在两层各兜一次，每层各有一条用例钉着 |

readme.section: 数据与隐私
readme.text:
| 面 | 事实 |
| --- | --- |
| 进程边界 | 被审查仓库的路径与 diff 内容进 `ocr` 子进程，CLI 再把它们发给自己在 config.json 里配置的 LLM 端点——这条外发是审查功能本身，不经 dsh 宿主。明文 key 不进工具返回、也不进 Remote 应答；宿主侧解析到的值只用于确认「现在解析得到」，当场丢弃 |
| 原始输出脱敏 | 本包出去的 CLI 原始 stdout/stderr（失败详情、llm test、解析失败回显、session 透传）统一过 `redactKeyMaterial()`：Bearer 与赋值形态从严抹除，独立 key 形态额外要求随机串特征，免得把要交给模型的文件路径一起抹掉 |
| 写盘范围 | CLI 的 `config.json`（含临时文件、`.bak` 备份与短暂的锁）、系统临时目录下的 `ocr-review-*` / `ocr-scan-*`（读完即删），以及 `ocr-session-export-*` 目录——那是 `ocr_session` 的 `export` 返回的 HTML，留给调用方，不自动删除。迁移前的明文可能留在那次写入产生的 `.bak` 里（权限 0600）——要彻底清掉需自行删除该备份。这些之外，`ocrNoAutoUpdate` 没置真时唯一的写者就是 CLI 自己那层 npm 包装 |

readme.section: 已知边界
readme.text:
- **Windows 没有收割、也没有自定义配置路径。** 两者都立在 POSIX 工具链上（bash trap、进程组语义、`HOME=` 赋值前缀）；Windows 上本包按裸命令执行、不收割，宿主硬退出可能留下孤儿 OCR 进程。
- **版本对不上从不当硬失败。** 新版 CLI 通常照样能用；两个数字并列显示、徽标改口、摘要 `hint` 加一句。本包从不执行安装动作。
- **读版本要起一次进程**，页面渲染绝不触发；卡片只显示最近一次测量或什么都不显示——渲染一页装不了、更不了、也探不了任何东西。
- **原子写的锁超时以英文出现。** 争用超过官方等待上限时抛的是官方件自己的超时文本——这是本包唯一一条绕过双语消息表的用户可见错误。
- **`partial` 是终态里的成功档。** 部分文件失败但覆盖仍成立、评论仍有效；既不被抬成成功，也不被折进失败。
- **无主的后台作业对所有会话可见**（见「后台运行与官方作业」）。解析不到活 Agent 的调用会起这种作业；有主作业则被围栏在自己的会话里。

readme.section: 常见问题
readme.text:
| 现象 / 问题 | 结论 |
| --- | --- |
| 把 exit 0 当成评审成功 | exit 0 不等于成功：`status` 不在 success / complete / partial / completed_with_warnings / completed_with_errors / skipped 白名单内即按失败报。`failed` 在名单里但**单独判成不成功**——它是 CLI 非零退出时照发的那份回执，覆盖明细（哪些文件没审成）由它承载，不与「解析失败、回显原文」混同。`partial` 指部分文件失败、但覆盖与评论仍有效。解析失败时回显脱敏后原文的前 500 个 UTF-16 码元 |
| 摘要有没有覆盖全部产出？ | 两件不同的事，不能互相替代。`droppedCount` / `invalidCommentCount` 只说明**本摘要**有没有列全评论（调大 `maxComments` 或置 0 再复核）。**这一场**有没有把选中的文件审完看 `coverage`（`selected` 是分母，`failedItems` 给出文件名与原因）、`budgetExceeded` 与 `toolCalls` |
| `add` 被拒，报 `already-installed` | HMR profile 对已装包的 `add` 在 pnpm 动手之前就拒——先 `remove` 再 `add` 目标版本（见「安装」） |
| dsh 退出时后台进程怎么办？ | 收割守护在任何宿主退出方式下（含 kill -9 后被收养）以 TERM→1s→KILL 收走 review/scan 的进程树；取消工具调用即终止对应的后台进程 |
| 明文 key 还可能留在哪？ | 本包写盘的地方没有它。迁移前配置里的明文可能留在迁移后第一次写入产生的 `.bak` 里（权限 0600）；删掉那份备份即彻底清除 |

readme.section: 开发
readme.text:
```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run check   # typecheck（两侧）→ lint → client 构建 → host 构建 → 带 coverage 的测试 → 格式检查
```

readme.section: 开发
readme.text:
- 覆盖率阈值**四项 100%**，分母是 `vitest.config.ts` 里 `coverageInclude` 选定的那一面（`host.ts` + `lib/**`）；两块刻意在分母外：客户端半（`src/**`）经 bundle 与设置卡用例覆盖，`scripts/get-cred.mjs` 由进程级用例另起进程驱动（v8 覆盖率看不到子进程），它的行为门禁在 `test/get-cred.test.ts`。
- 往 profile 加本包的**本地目录**（`pnpm add <路径>`）需要 pnpm ≥ 12.3.0：更早的 pnpm 12 把无别名的本地路径当 registry 包名解析（上游 #14437，12.3.0 修复）。从 registry 装不受影响。
- 产物新鲜度由 `test/build-host.test.ts` 钉着：`host.js` / `client.js` 落后于源码就红。发布物不手改；`prepare` 重建。
- 插件源码是 TypeScript，由宿主的 cordis Loader 直接加载（Node ≥ 22.18 类型剥离）；bundle 只为 npm 发布面存在。从本地目录安装（`pnpm add <路径>`）读的是源码，因此需要 Node ≥ 22.18，而本包自己声明的地板是 `engines.node`（`>=24.9.0`）。
